topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: I don’t know how to say no, even as I watch the boundary between our yards blur like the edges of shadows at dusk. The idea of tilled earth and foreign plants taking root where my family has walked for years unsettles me. I nod, agreeing, though my mouth feels dry and my words come out too quickly. The neighbor’s smile is warm, but it does little to ease the tightness in my chest. I promise to talk it over with my family, though I know what the answer will be. I step back, almost too eager to close the door, hoping that once it’s shut, the lines will straighten themselves out again, and the world will feel a little more solid.
